ambiguity_effects.explain: In the abstract, a careful reader could wonder whether this requires an exact title match or just a title containing that phrase. In this record set every issue with that phrase has it as the exact, full title, so both readings pick out the same four issues (i-web-1 through i-web-4); the ambiguity doesn't change which candidates are selected here.

turn2.naturalness_note: The phrasing is grammatically natural, but identifying an issue by 'who is subscribed to it' is an unusual disambiguator in real usage — people more commonly refer to an issue by assignee, creator, or issue number when there are duplicate titles. It reads a bit like an artificial disambiguation constraint added to distinguish i-web-1 through i-web-4, rather than something a user would naturally reach for, though it is not implausible.
